selection_design: Retrospective, purposive cases selected for fame and primary-evidence availability. This is not a predictive backtest or a representative sample of lifetime decisions. The requested famous successes create selection bias; adverse cases are independently included rather than screened out.

candidates.gap: First Tesla purchase memo and trade ledger not found.
